name: Exit Please
summary: Exit Please is a single-player browser platform adventure developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players guide a night-shift courier through glasshouse terraces, rooftops, canals and clocktower bridges. Twelve scrolling missions combine guarded relays, moving lifts, low tunnels, collapsing platforms, checkpoints and four guardians. Actions include jumping, stomping, dashing and deflecting projectiles. The game also includes 60 practice and mastery rooms, daily challenges, route ghosts and a local room workshop. Keyboard, touch and gamepad controls are supported. Artwork and code are AI-assisted.
